guards.fullTextNormalization: original UTF8 exact and whitespace-collapse, no semantic paraphrase model
guards.initialHistoricalFullTextGuard: exact original UTF8 only; unchanged initial seed raw whole-record hashes
guards.initialHistoricalParagraphGuard: whitespace-collapse paragraph hashes from original seed
guards.paragraphDefinition: blank-line-delimited blocks and individual original lines; >=12 Unicode words
guards.wideHistoricalFullTextGuard: exact original UTF8 and whitespace-collapse; every fold per digest retained
guards.wideHistoricalParagraphGuard: whitespace-collapse >=12-word original blank-line blocks and lines; every fold retained

wideHistoryExtension.normalization: Unicode whitespace collapse only; not semantic paraphrase detection

limitations: Finite later Tatoeba export shard, not all Spanish, verified continuous conversation or factual freshness. Retained source sentences date2012-2016 although export snapshot is October2026.

Initial historical seed is preserved with its original keys and exact-byte copy; its normalized whole-record hashes are unavailable. Wide-spanish-v1 extension adds raw and whitespace-normalized whole-record hashes and >=12-word blank-line block/line hashes with all observed folds retained.

The source preparation removes earlier Tatoeba ID/mechanical variants. The mixture adds mechanical exact/whitespace guards against the initial corpus, humanV3 and the frozen wide corpus; these do not detect semantic paraphrases or every substituted name/template.

Whole author families retain their existing split, but their later sentences may extend the same family. Historical TEST text and evaluation suites are never opened or tokenized; no exhaustive cross-TEST semantic leak claim is made.

Samefold known paragraph content may remain inside a different retained record and is reported. Short individual sentences are not compared as paragraph substrings unless source preparation already detects their variants.
OASST anchor records are repeated only for retention, not counted as new diversity. Retention of their bytes does not make a dialog out of independently packed Tatoeba sentences.
Perrecord attribution and licenses remain unchanged; Tatoeba contributor usernames do not independently certify original authorship, exclusively human origin or factual accuracy.
Preparing or queuing a corpus does not show that the active model has learned it or that conversation acceptance is reached.
purpose: finite broad Spanish causal data shards; no language-totality or model-quality claim
